claims.claim: A successful PRIMARY RUN automatically exposes aios/review/<RUN_ID> at the exact canonical head_sha and aios/artifacts/<RUN_ID> containing byte-exact persisted run.json and result.json at the fixed transport paths.
A successful REMEDIATION run uses the same reusable post-PASS transport contract and transports only that remediation RUN identity and canonical ResultPackage.
The capability is owned by AIOS-renew operator code and works from the current repository/upstream configuration without product-repository or executor-specific transport implementations.
Transport never changes product HEAD, worktree, or main, never allows the selected Executor to push, and never runs for STATUS or non-PASS execution.

Repeating transport for the same canonical head_sha and byte-exact RUN and ResultPackage is idempotent even if a newly constructed Git artifacts commit would have different non-semantic metadata; genuinely different remote candidate or artifact content fails closed.

Focused deterministic tests cover PRIMARY and REMEDIATION transport, exact candidate and artifact binding, reusable remote selection, unchanged repository state, no transport on non-PASS paths, identical-state idempotency by transported content, real conflicting remote state, and successful package/operator import without source-spelling assertions.
